pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregular dark brown patches with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the margins. Geometry varies from large, quadrangular shapes on the upper flank to smaller, more fragmented and stellate shapes on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Inter-patch spacing is relatively narrow. Junction nodes predominantly exhibit trivalent (Y-shaped) and tetravalent (X-shaped) topology.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark, bristly mane visible along the dorsal cervical ridge, exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian symbionts (Oxpeckers) clinging to the mane and the posterior flank area.
